extDesc.message: Right-click selected text to search on Google, then auto-open the top matching result from your preferred sites. Built-in packs for books, videos, shopping, research and more; switch instantly with shortcuts.

actionTitle.message: Google Search Direct - click to switch site pack

contextMenuFallback.message: Google Search and open top site results

cmdSwitch4.message: Switch to site pack 4 (assign in shortcut settings)

cmdSwitch5.message: Switch to site pack 5 (assign in shortcut settings)

cmdSwitch6.message: Switch to site pack 6 (assign in shortcut settings)

cmdSwitch7.message: Switch to site pack 7 (assign in shortcut settings)

cmdSwitch8.message: Switch to site pack 8 (assign in shortcut settings)

cmdCycle.message: Cycle to the next site pack

popupHintRight.message: Right-click selected text to open results by pack priority

keyPopupTitle.message: Press number key $1 in this popup; you can also assign a global key at chrome://extensions/shortcuts

optSubtitle.message: Set a priority list of sites for each interest; switch instantly from the toolbar or with shortcuts

modeNewTab.message: Open in a new tab (recommended, keeps Google results)

configPlaceholder.message: Click "Export" to generate config, or paste someone else's config and click "Import"

help1.message: 1. Each pack is a priority-ordered domain list: the first site with a matching result is opened; if none match, the next one is tried.

help2.message: 2. Click "Activate" on a card to choose the current pack. Click the toolbar icon to switch quickly; inside the popup, press 1-8 to jump to a pack or 0 to cycle.

help3.message: 3. Chrome allows only 4 preset shortcuts: Alt+Shift+1/2/3 and Alt+Shift+0. To bind global keys for packs 4-8, or if a preset key is taken, open "Shortcuts" and assign your own.

help4.message: 4. You can omit https:// and www. in domains. Use legitimate sites only; do not add pirated resources.

help5.message: 5. Select text, right-click, then choose "Google Search and open ... results".

builtinNoDelete.message: Built-in packs cannot be deleted; you can clear their domains

emptyPack.message: This pack has no sites yet. Add one below.

confirmReset.message: Restore built-in packs? Your edits will be lost, but custom packs will be kept at the end.

resetDone.message: Built-in packs restored. Remember to click "Save settings".

exportDone.message: Configuration generated. Select all and copy to share.

copyFail.message: Copy failed. Please select all and copy manually

importBadJson.message: Invalid JSON. Check the pasted content

importNoPacks.message: No valid site packs in the config

saveAtLeastOne.message: Keep at least one site pack

savedSummary.message: Saved $1 packs with $2 sites total (in pack order)

presetHint.message: New installs use the site list for your browser language. You can override it here; your custom packs are kept. The interface language follows Chrome.

localeSwitched.message: Switched to $1. Remember to click "Save settings".
